title: 這個瓜妳敲過三遍了
mood: flirty roadside haggling in the heat
subject: a melon grower at his roadside stall outside Turpan and the woman on an e-bike who knocks every melon on the pile and still won't buy
caption: Xinjiang folk-pop in the Daolang style, built on a Uyghur dance groove. A dap frame drum played by hand in a driving dum-tek dance pattern, doubled by tambourine; a plucked dutar ostinato in a muqam-flavoured mode with an augmented second; an accordion answering each vocal line; a violin obbligato sliding between phrases; a pop kit with the snare on two and four over a warm synth pad. Warm and roomy like a roadside wedding band, the frame drum and the voices forward, the dutar wide. Male voice, a husky, weathered baritone with declamatory phrasing and melismatic turns on held notes; a bright female voice sings every answering line. 116 BPM, D minor. Flirty roadside haggling in the heat. No free-rhythm hua'er calls, no erhu, no guzheng, no banhu, no suona, no trap drums, no EDM synths, no rock distortion, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, frame drum dance pattern and dutar ostinato]

[Verse 1 - Male]
出了吐魯番三十公里 瓜攤搭在白楊樹下
哈密瓜一堆 西瓜一堆 秤是我爸的老秤
妳把電動車停在路邊 安全帽也不拿下
一個一個敲過去 像醫生在聽心跳

[Chorus - Male, female answers]
這個瓜妳敲過三遍了
(敲三遍 才知道甜不甜)
妳要不要切開看看 刀我已經擦乾淨了
(先不要 我再敲一個)

[Verse 2 - Male]
太陽曬到秤盤都燙手 妳還在敲第三排
我說姑娘 這一車都是我自己種的
妳說 那你說說看 哪一個最甜
我拍拍胸口 最甜的那個 正在跟妳講話

[Interlude - accordion and violin trade phrases over the frame drum]

[Chorus - Male, female answers]
這個瓜妳敲過三遍了
(敲三遍 才知道你老不老實)
送妳一個 下星期再來敲
(下星期 我帶我媽一起來)

[Outro - frame drum alone, then the dutar ostinato]
她騎走了 西瓜放在腳踏板上
我坐回樹蔭下 敲了敲自己的頭
